text:
alex: Found a mysterious potato on the office couch this morning. Not claiming it, but it's judging my emails.
maria: Is it the 'meetings-are-fine' type of potato or 'urgent-kernel-update' potato?
sam: Please tell me it's not the one that keeps rearranging desk plants. That spud is a serial decorator.
nora: If we're naming it, I vote 'Couch Spud' or 'Sir Tots-a-lot'. Vote with emoji.
alex: Poll: :one: Couch Spud  :two: Sir Tots-a-lot
maria: :one: Couch Spud. Also: can someone check if the potato has a badge?
sam: Checked. No badge. Tiny sticker that says "Out of Office (for now)" though.
safety-bot: Heads up: decorative items must not exceed 12" in any direction near exits. (automated safety reminder)
nora: Noted safety-bot. Couch Spud will be briefed on evacuation routes.
alex: Plan: adopt as interim mascot, make a tiny cape, and pin a name tag. If anyone objects, DM me.
maria: I'll make a tiny name tag template and upload to #design in 10.
sam: GIF incoming: <link_to_gif_potato_nod.gif> caption: "When Q3 hits but you still play it cool."
nora: I'm bringing craft supplies. If we get a cape, it should be removable for washing. 
alex: Cape procurement: in process. Also setting a 2pm "introduce the mascot" 5-min standup. All welcome but potatoes do not get voting rights.
maria: Also adding 'how to gently pat the potato' to the fun-stuff wiki. Please keep pressure gentle.
sam: Also who has spare socks? In case of emergency spud-laundering.
nora: I have one extra sock. It will be ceremonially offered.
alex: Resolution: Couch Spud adopted, cape in progress, safety-checked by safety-bot, craft hour scheduled. Thread closed unless the potato moves desks. :seedling: :tada:
